name: cenk-jobs
description: The cenk-jobs plugin from this repository: for a clone you work on, or a private copy you were invited to. Everyone else installs it from Cenk Simsek's public catalog cenk (github.com/cenksimsek1988/claude-plugins).

plugins.name: cenk-jobs
plugins.description: Your job search with Claude: finds and screens job postings, writes CVs and cover letters from your own facts, applies in your own Chrome on its own whenever your records answer every question, tracks every application, puts interviews and deadlines in Google Calendar, and prepares each hiring step. Your data stays in your Google Drive.
